source_context: While investigating OEIS A053067, GPT-5.6 Sol / ChatGPT derived a fixed-width concatenation recurrence and residue-one mechanism. This validation branch first promotes the already kernel-checked algebraic core from the research workspace into the ordinary LeanFrontier namespace; the intended final submission will extend it to the unconditional fixed-width residue-one theorem and its finite-prime-avoidance consequences.
